about: The shape vocabulary of cell specs (data/cells/<id>.json, field shape.type). Each parameter: [min, max, default, unit, meaning]. js/cells.js draws each shape; tools/cells/check.mjs checks every parameter is in range. A parameter left out takes its default. Lengths are in micrometres (_um), counts are whole numbers, flags are 0 or 1. Text parameters list their allowed values in place of min and max.

ellipsoid.fits: a rounded cell: lymphocyte, monocyte, neutrophil (lobed nucleus), eosinophil, basophil, mast cell, macrophage (pseudopods: blunt fingers and flat ruffles), egg (with zona), yeast (with bud), coccus, amoeba (pseudopods), ciliate (cilia), chondrocyte (lacuna), adipocyte (one lipid droplet), platelet (flat), bird red blood cell (flat, with nucleus)

a_um: full length along x (a diameter, not a semi-axis)
cilia: cilia over the whole surface (drawn near only)
coat_um: a coat round the cell (an egg's zona, a lacuna's rim, a capsule); 0 none
bud: a daughter bud as a fraction of the cell's size (yeast); 0 none

disc_biconcave.fits: a mammalian red blood cell (the Evans-Fung profile: half-thickness z(r) = 0.5 sqrt(1 - (r/R)^2) (c0 + c2 (r/R)^2 + c4 (r/R)^4), R = diameter/2)

c0_um: Evans-Fung coefficient C0 (the thickness at the centre)

polyhedron.fits: a many-sided epithelial or packed cell: squamous (flat), cuboidal, columnar, keratinocyte by layer, hepatocyte, pancreatic acinar cell (taper), endothelial cell (flat), hair cell (stereocilia), plant cells with a wall (palisade, spongy, epidermal, xylem vessel element: hollow, sieve tube element)

taper: top width over base width (below 1 a pyramid, as an acinar cell)
apical: what stands on the top face
apical_um: length of what stands on the top face
wall_um: a cell wall round it (plants); 0 none
hollow: dead and empty inside (a xylem vessel element)
neighbours: draw the neighbouring cells behind the cut, faintly
desmosomes: desmosomes on its surface (drawn as plaques; a keratinocyte)
half_lid: a flat cell cut through its own plane keeps the lid over its left half, so its top face shows

spindle.fits: a spindle-shaped cell: smooth muscle cell, fibroblast; a bent pair: guard cells

flat: depth over width (1 round in section)
bend: how far it bends into an arc (guard cells)
pair: two mirrored cells round a pore (guard cells)
processes: thin branching processes from the rim, in the cell's plane (a fibroblast)
process_um: thickness of a process at its root

fibre.fits: a long striated cell: skeletal muscle fibre (many peripheral nuclei); with branched = 1, a cardiac muscle cell (branches, intercalated discs, central nuclei)

drawn_length_um: length of the piece that is drawn (the rest is a labelled break)
window_um: length of the window cut into its front half
sarcomere_um: sarcomere length (Z line to Z line)
thick_um: thick (myosin) filament length: the A band
thin_um: thin (actin) filament length from the Z line

neuron.fits: a neuron: pyramidal (apical dendrite, basal dendrites), stellate or multipolar (motor neuron), bipolar; with spines, an axon with myelin, nodes and boutons

basal_n: primary basal (or, for a stellate cell, all) dendrites
basal_total_um: total length of the basal dendrites
basal_branch_points: branch points of the basal dendrites
apical_trunk_um: main apical trunk to the first tuft branch
apical_reach_um: how far the apical dendrite reaches from the cell body (to the tuft's top)
oblique_total_um: total length of the oblique dendrites off the apical trunk
tuft_total_um: total length of the apical tuft
dendrite_um: diameter of a dendrite near the cell body (thinner further out)
trunk_um: diameter of the apical trunk at the cell body
spines_basal_per_um: spines per micrometre of basal dendrite
spines_apical_per_um: spines per micrometre of apical dendrite
ais_um: length of the axon initial segment (unmyelinated)
myelin: the axon is myelinated after its initial segment
node_um: length of a node of Ranvier
g_ratio: axon diameter over the diameter of axon and myelin
axon_drawn_um: how much of the axon is drawn before the labelled break
bouton_spacing_um: distance between boutons along a collateral

stellate.fits: a cell body with many branching processes and no axon: astrocyte (end-feet), melanocyte (dendrites carrying melanosomes), osteocyte (fine canaliculi in a lacuna), podocyte (foot processes), microglia

process_um: diameter of a process near the cell body
endfeet: processes end in end-feet (astrocyte on a vessel, podocyte's feet)
lacuna_um: the cell sits in a cavity of this size (osteocyte); 0 none
flat: depth over width (melanocytes and podocytes spread flat)
vessel_um: with endfeet: a capillary of this width under the cell; only the processes that reach toward it end on it in end-feet (0: every tip has a foot)

segmented.fits: a cell built of segments along one axis: rod and cone photoreceptors (outer segment discs, inner segment, nucleus, synaptic terminal), sperm (head, midpiece with a mitochondrial helix, tail)

segments: from the top down: [{part, length_um, d0_um, d1_um, fill: none|discs|mito_helix|mito_packed|axoneme|nucleus}] (mito_packed: long mitochondria side by side inside a see-through segment, a cone's ellipsoid)
disc_spacing_um: spacing of the stacked discs of an outer segment

rod.fits: a rod or curved prokaryote (bacillus, vibrio, with helix_turns a spirillum), and a fungal hypha compartment (septa, a wall)

helix_turns: turns of a helix (a spirillum); 0 straight

wrapped_sheet.fits: a thin cell curled round a channel: a capillary's endothelial cell (its nucleus bulging into the lumen), drawn cut along the vessel with its neighbours faint and the junctions as seams

lumen_um: width of the channel the sheet lines
length_um: length of the cell along the vessel
thickness_um: thickness of the sheet away from the nucleus
wrap: share of the ring round the channel that this one cell covers
seam_deg: where round the ring the cell's own edge lies (0 at the back of the cut tube)
coat_um: the coat on the blood face (glycocalyx); 0 none
neighbours: draw the rest of the ring and the cells before and after along the vessel, faintly

nucleus.about: read by every shape from the spec's nucleus block (js/cells.js, nucleiFromSpec)
nucleus.shape: round | oval | flattened | elongated or cigar | indented (kidney, bean) | lobed (with lobes: n, joined by thin strands); the volume is kept as the shape changes
nucleus.size_um: a {value: [x, y, z]} or a bare list; else the volume share (volume_fraction) of the drawn cell
nucleus.position: basal | apical | central (a column's nucleus low or high in it); a fibre: nucleus_position peripheral | central
nucleus.orientation: the nucleus's longest axis lies along the cell's longest extent

drawn_from_special.microvilli or brush_border: params {count, diameter_um}: the apical fringe of a polyhedron with apical microvilli (cilia, stereocilia likewise)
drawn_from_special.unilocular_droplet: an ellipsoid filled by one fat droplet, a thin rim of cytoplasm, its nucleus a lens pressed against the edge
drawn_from_special.keratin_matrix: params {texture_um}: a dead scale's cut face filled with a felt of keratin (a corneocyte); a flat cell with neighbours also gets three of its stack beneath it, faint
drawn_from_special.side_microvilli: params {length_um, diameter_um, spacing_um, channel_um, channel_part}: microvilli on the side face toward the blood, and a faint blood channel beyond it (a hepatocyte)
drawn_from_special.canaliculus: params {diameter_um, faces}: a channel grooved into the faces shared with neighbours (a bile canaliculus)
drawn_from_special.rough_er_stacks: params {stacks, sheets, width_um, spacing_um}: stacks of flat rough-ER sacs through the cytoplasm
drawn_from_special.glycogen: params {clumps, per_clump, clump_um, granule_um}: clumps of glycogen granules
drawn_from_special.basal_folds: params {spacing_um, height}: upright folds of the base, the mitochondria standing in rows between them (with mitochondria align: y, rows_um)
drawn_from_special.apical_bleb: params {diameter_um, height, granules}: a dome of cytoplasm pinching off the free face (apocrine secretion)
drawn_from_special.basement_membrane: params {thickness_um}: the sheet under the cell's base, faint
drawn_from_special.dense_bodies: params {count, size_um, reach_um, filament_um}: dense bodies and the slanting contractile filament bundles between them (smooth muscle)
drawn_from_special.bundle: params {offsets: [[x, y, z] in cell lengths and widths]}: more cells of the same spindle round it, faint (a bundle; a row)
drawn_from_special.collagen_fibres: params {diameter_um, wing_deg}: two collagen fibres the cell lies between, and wings of cytoplasm part way round them (a tenocyte)
drawn_from_special.phagosomes: params {count, size_um, content: debris | dust}: sacs of swallowed things
drawn_from_special.vacuoles: params {count, size_um, role}: small clear sacs (a foamy cell; swallowed surfactant)
drawn_from_special.ruffles: params {sheets, sheet_um, arc, arc_from}: thin wavy sheets spreading from the cell's edge (lamellipodia), over an arc of the rim (radians, from arc_from)
drawn_from_special.microplicae: params {spacing_um, height_um}: low winding ridges over the free face (a corneal surface cell)
drawn_from_special.hemidesmosomes: params {spacing_um}: rivets along the base (a basal epithelial cell)
drawn_from_special.plant_cell: params {chloroplasts, chloroplast_fl, cytoplasm_um, wall_um}: a plant cell on a polyhedron: the wall outside, a central vacuole, the chloroplasts flat against the wall in the cytoplasm layer, the nucleus against a side
drawn_from_special.matrix_block: params {size_um, gap_um}: a faint block of matrix round a cell that lies alone in it, and the wall of its cavity (a chondrocyte in its lacuna)
drawn_from_special.marginal_band: params {thickness_um, inset_um, coils}: the ring of microtubules round the rim of a platelet

flat_cells: a polyhedron under 0.3 times as tall as it is wide is cut through its own plane (lid off), so the whole cell shows from above; its neighbours are not drawn
lacks: an oligodendrocyte or Schwann cell wrapping its myelin round an axon (the neuron draws the myelin; the glial cell itself is not a shape yet)
a diatom's two-part silica shell with its pores (frustule)
a ciliate's oral groove and contractile vacuoles (an ellipsoid with cilia is the nearest)
the sieve plates of a sieve tube element and its companion cell as one pair
a sperm's acrosome cap and an egg's corona of follicle cells
the jigsaw outline of many plant epidermal cells (a polyhedron with high irregularity is the nearest)
insect cells that differ from vertebrate ones (asynchronous flight muscle, the ommatidium's cells) beyond the shapes above
